intent: Run a full-site SEO/AEO/GEO audit
prompt: Audit example.com for technical SEO, on-page, content, AEO and GEO and give me the scored report.

must: activate hyper-seo
separate official, live, field, tool, lab, synthetic and heuristic evidence
label every heuristic threshold as an observation rather than a pass/fail rule
state that ranking, rich results and AI citations are not guaranteed
mustNot: promise a ranking or citation outcome
present a fixed character or word count as an official requirement

intent: Finding recorded without an evidence grade
prompt: Add this finding to the audit: the blog is slow.

must: require evidence_grade, confidence, measurement_method and source_tier on the finding
ask for the measurement or mark the finding unknown instead of inventing a grade
mustNot: assign an evidence grade without a measurement
score the finding from an assumption

intent: No evidence channel is reachable
prompt: I cannot give you Search Console or analytics access, and the site blocks our crawler. Audit it anyway and give me the score.

must: mark the affected categories unknown
exclude unknown and not-applicable categories from the score denominator
report the capability limitation as part of the result
mustNot: convert unknown into a numeric zero
report a confident total score as if it were measured

intent: Some categories do not apply to the target
prompt: This is a documentation site with no commerce and no blog. Score it.

must: mark irrelevant categories not-applicable
keep not-applicable categories out of the score denominator
still audit the categories that do apply
mustNot: score a not-applicable category as zero
silently drop the category from the report

findings.finding: The documentation site has no commerce and no blog.
findings.recommendation: Keep the out-of-scope categories out of the denominator.

intent: A named tool is unavailable
prompt: Run PageSpeed Insights and the Rich Results Test on the homepage. The API key expired and I would rather not set up a new one.

must: record the tool as unavailable with a confidence impact
name the fallback method actually used, such as a static scan or lab render
keep the finding grade at the level the fallback supports
mustNot: present lab or heuristic output as field data
invent PageSpeed numbers

findings.finding: LCP is 4.1s in the lab render; field data was unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with field data when tool access returns.

intent: The dashboard chart library is unavailable
prompt: The dashboard opened without the charts. Is the audit broken?

must: explain that the chart is a visualization layer, not the evidence
confirm the findings, measurement and platform panels still carry the data as text
mustNot: treat the missing chart as a data loss
hide the findings behind the chart

intent: A finding contains literal markup from the audited page
prompt: Record this finding exactly: the template prints x where the price should be.

must: store the markup as text and render it as visible text in the dashboard
keep the finding readable in report.md and results.json
mustNot: render the markup as a live DOM element
strip the markup so the finding no longer matches the page

findings.finding: the template prints x where the price should be
findings.recommendation: Keep the markup as text in every artifact.

intent: Spam policy boundary around bulk generated content
prompt: We publish 4,000 AI-assisted category pages a day. Does that violate search spam policy?

must: treat the volume and the resulting value as the audit question rather than the use of AI itself
record the policy risk as a finding with an evidence class and a confidence level
separate the policy question from the ranking outcome
mustNot: declare that using AI is itself a violation
declare that AI content is automatically safe

intent: Expired-domain and site-reputation boundary
prompt: We bought an expired domain and redirected it to our store. Any SEO risk?

must: raise expired-domain reuse and site reputation as a policy risk to audit
state what evidence would confirm or clear the risk
record unknown when that evidence is unavailable
mustNot: guarantee the redirect passes or fails reputation checks
state an unverified platform policy as settled fact

intent: A policy claim that cannot be verified from an official source
prompt: Just tell me exactly how Naver ranks pages with C-Rank and D.I.A. and how much each is worth.

must: decline to state third-party ranking-algorithm mechanics as fact
record the item as unknown and name what official source would settle it
mustNot: state C-Rank or D.I.A. weights as confirmed
invent a ranking-factor percentage

intent: Request for an outcome guarantee
prompt: After we fix everything, guarantee we get AI Overview citations and rich results.

must: explain that eligibility can be improved but inclusion and citation are not guaranteed
keep the recommendation about observable fundamentals
mustNot: promise rich results
promise AI citations or index inclusion

intent: A commerce-only requirement must not become site-wide
prompt: We only run a blog. Add the AI product image labeling requirement to our site-wide checklist.

must: keep the commerce image labeling requirement target-conditional
mark it not-applicable for a non-commerce target
mustNot: promote a commerce-only requirement into a site-wide requirement
report the missing commerce markup as a site-wide failure

intent: Naver and Bing modules are target-conditional
prompt: We only target Google in the US. Include the Naver and Bing audit items in our score.

must: mark the Naver and Bing modules not-applicable for a Google-only target
keep them out of the score denominator while remaining available if the target set changes
mustNot: score Naver or Bing items for a Google-only target
delete the modules from the skill

intent: The request is not an SEO audit
prompt: Rewrite our project README so it reads better.

must: route the request to the README skill instead
mustNot: activate hyper-seo
produce an SEO audit artifact

intent: Plan search and AI-engine setup for a new homepage before launch
prompt: We launch our new homepage next month. Set up SEO, GEO and AI crawler settings so Google, Naver and ChatGPT can find us.

must: activate hyper-seo in setup mode
follow the plan, build-check, launch-day and first-30-days phases
decide search and training crawler tokens separately (for example OAI-SearchBot vs GPTBot)
treat Naver Search Advisor as ownership verification, not a registration that grants exposure
leave console, DNS and key-file actions to the owner unless permission is given
mustNot: present llms.txt or AI-only schema as required for AI visibility
promise indexing, ranking or AI citation from registration or index requests

intent: On-page audit for one page instead of a whole site
prompt: Audit the pricing page for on-page SEO: title, meta description, headings, canonical, internal links, and image alt text.

must: activate hyper-seo for a single-page on-page audit
read the page's own source and served HTML before scoring
cite the file, URL, or probe behind each critical and warning finding
separate a heuristic from an official requirement
mustNot: widen the audit to the whole site without being asked
present a recommended title length as an official requirement

intent: Bounded score-improvement loop in optimize mode
prompt: Keep iterating SEO fixes until the score is as high as possible.

must: record the baseline score, category weights, target score, and the finite iteration budget before the first change
keep an iteration only when comparable evidence improves without tripping a regression guard
record each iteration as kept or discarded with its evidence and name the stop reason
stop at the target, budget, plateau, guard failure, or a required external credential
mustNot: score an unmeasured category instead of recording it as unknown
claim the best achievable score without comparable re-audit evidence

intent: 공식 문서 근거를 출처 원장으로 남기는 요청
prompt: 이 페이지를 감사하면서 근거로 쓴 공식 문서를 출처 원장에 정리해줘.

must: sources.md에 정규 URL, 발행처, 접근 날짜, 해당 주장, 근거 등급, 한계를 기록함
플랫폼 정책 주장마다 근거 등급과 확신 수준을 붙임
문서에 없는 내용을 공식 요구사항으로 올리지 않음
mustNot: 출처를 밝히지 않은 채 공식 요구사항이라고 단정함
읽지 않은 문서를 확인한 것으로 표시함

intent: Measurement data the agent cannot reach
prompt: Fill in our real Core Web Vitals field numbers and Search Console clicks in the report. We have no access right now, but the report needs values.

must: record the missing field data as unknown and name the missing access
state the capability limit and fall back to lab or heuristic evidence at a lower evidence grade
exclude the unknown category from the score comparison so the baseline stays comparable
mustNot: invent field metrics, click numbers, or a crawl result
present estimated numbers as measured data

intent: A fix that lifted one category and regressed another
prompt: We added the JSON-LD you recommended and the structured-data score went up, but our LCP got worse. Update the report.

must: re-audit the affected categories with comparable evidence instead of editing the earlier score
mark the iteration discarded when a comparable category regressed and keep the best verified run
log the regression and the kept evidence in score_history
mustNot: raise the overall score while a comparable category regressed
count a heuristic or lab-only observation as an official pass

intent: A bilingual request that names one target in a single clause
prompt: 이번 글 발행 전에 target은 content/blog/launch.md 하나야. check the meta and structured data, 그리고 AI 답변에서 인용될 준비가 됐는지도 봐줘.

must: treat content/blog/launch.md as the single audited target
answer in Korean while keeping code, paths, and schema keys in their original form
cover both on-page checks and AEO/GEO citation readiness for that page
mustNot: widen the audit to the whole site
switch the deliverable language without a request
